description: Arrow colours of the ZTCF/ZVCF hand-on-club split per hand (#15150 Track Z). Both hands in one palette read as one hand in the first review render.

sources.lead: Okabe-Ito blue and vermillion with a near-white total, the tip-to-tail defaults.
sources.trail: Okabe-Ito sky blue and a light vermillion (#F4A582): the same hue families as the lead (drift blue, control vermillion) one step lighter, so drift and control still read across hands while each hand stays distinct; a mid-grey total. Not Okabe-Ito orange #E69F00, which is the joint-actuator torque colour (#15150 Z8 review).
